scenario_text: You receive an SMS: 'Your account is locked. Click here to secure it: bit.ly/...'. What do you do?
option_b_text: Call your bank using the number on your card

scenario_text: You're on public Wi‑Fi and need to check your bank balance. What do you do?
option_a_text: Log in to your bank directly over public Wi‑Fi
option_b_text: Use mobile data or a trusted VPN before logging in
option_c_text: Use a private/incognito browser window on public Wi‑Fi

scenario_text: An email says: 'Unusual login detected—update password here' with a link. What do you do?
option_a_text: Click the link to update password
option_b_text: Report phishing; navigate to bank manually to check

scenario_text: An ATM shows an error and has a sticker with a support number to call. What do you do?
option_a_text: Call the number on the ATM sticker
option_b_text: Use the official bank app/support to verify/report
option_c_text: Use another ATM and monitor account closely

scenario_text: You get a call 'from your bank' asking for a one‑time passcode to verify your account. What do you do?
option_a_text: Provide the passcode to the caller
option_b_text: Refuse and call the bank back using the official number
option_c_text: Hang up and block the number
